newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - March 21.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on Friday:

WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan signaled that the central bank is likely to raise short-term interest rates when Fed policymakers meet on Tuesday. Fed officials said any increase would be no more than a quarter of a percentage point.
WASHINGTON - Delta Air Lines Inc. announced that it has reached a long-term agreement to buy all its airliners from Boeing Co. over the next 20 years.

WASHINGTON - In recent years, America Online Inc. has bombarded Americans with millions of CD-ROMs and diskettes to try to sign them up. Now a Baltimore company that organized the mailings contends AOL may put it out of business by unfairly refusing to pay it.

WASHINGTON - Executives at more than two dozen of the nation's largest corporations have been meeting quietly over the past year to brainstorm ways to recruit and retain workers who make less than $8.50 an hour.
